item.grandline.beli_pouch.amount: Holds %s Beli (use to add to your purse)
ship_upgrade.grandline.coating: Coating (one dive to the deep sea)
grandline.knock_up.warning: The sea is starting to boil... the Knock Up Stream erupts in %s s!
grandline.knock_up.launch: The Knock Up Stream! Hold on — we're going up!
grandline.sky.arrived: Welcome to the White Sea, 10,000 metres above the Blue Sea.
grandline.sky.cloud_end: The Cloud End — the long way down!
grandline.sky.landed: Splashdown! You're back on the Blue Sea, east of Jaya.
grandline.sky.fell: You fell through the sea of clouds...
grandline.deep.need_coating: Your ship needs a coating to dive — the coaters of Sabaody can do it.
grandline.deep.dive: The coated ship sinks beneath the waves...
grandline.deep.arrived: 10,000 metres down. Somewhere ahead lies Fish-Man Island.
grandline.deep.ascend: The current carries the ship up toward the surface...
grandline.deep.new_world: You've surfaced in the New World!
quest.grandline.execution_town.desc: Reach Loguetown and hear Bartolo the merchant tell how the old Pirate King's last words began the Saltfire Age.
grandline.weather.waves: Waves crash over the deck — reef the sails!
grandline.weather.navigator: Your navigator reads the sky: %s about %s blocks ahead. Change course or reef the sails.
grandline.prison.escaped: You broke out of the cell! Your bounty rises and the Marines are after you.
quest.grandline.awakening_trial.desc: Your Devil Fruit stirs. Prove your mastery: bring down twelve formidable foes with your fruit's own power, and set foot in the New World.
grandline.awakening.stirs: Your Devil Fruit stirs... a power deeper than you knew is waiting. (Quest: The Awakening Trial)
grandline.awakening.done: Your Devil Fruit has AWAKENED! Its hidden powers are yours to command.
grandline.ferry.board: A launch rows you out to the ferry lying off the island. All aboard for %s!
grandline.ferry.seatrain_board: The Puffing Tom whistles and pulls out for %s!
